Name: BFAV Peafowl
Author: cantabileChaos
Description:
This mod includes a BFAV file, a JA file and a PFM file. Five different colors of peafowl are available, each can produce a matching feather drop as well as peafowl eggs. Eggs can be made into mayo.

The JA portion of this mod includes gift preferences for characters only available through SVE. I ran this mod without those characters in the game and didn't run into any issues, but please let me know if this causes problems and I can release a version without these characters referenced. 

Please let me know as soon as you notice any problems so I can do my best to fix them.
